title: Before a lane's push, the guard runs the lane lint's fast checks on the commits it sends
why: The lane lint runs only after a lane's push, so the silent-undo check failed #1759 after it was pushed (lane lane-finds-triage, [ended:lane-finds-triage], relayed by the coordinator 08:12 CST Nov 8). The same class sent #2032's test commit out with no Red-run line. Each such gap after a push costs a replacement PR, since a force push is the owner's act. Sighting 03:03 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:03, from lane ci-fixes-mailaudit; the lane's claims, unchecked by the coordinator and triage, mailaudit is outside this session's GitHub scope): on mailaudit #329 the lane put the `Drops-lines:` line in its own paragraph; the merge tool refused it twice (heads 4b11a87, 56d9a41); fixed at 4a05762. Only `merge --confirm` reads the trailer shape (a Drops-lines line must sit in the last paragraph with Co-Authored-By), after the push. Proposal: a commit-time check of that shape. Triage read: this step is the home (the push-time check that calls the lane lint's own checks, no copy); the lane that builds it reads whether the lane lint already checks the trailer shape, and adds it if not. Same class as lint-before-record-push (STE lint miss) and red-run-pre-push; no new step (rule building-one-home-per-capability). The build lane lives in claude-settings (the check is in the shared tools, not in mailaudit).
note: Coordinator's proposal, 08:12 CST Nov 8: run `merge --lane-lint`, or its fast checks, before a lane's push. Not folded into red-run-pre-push: that step checks one trailer and its lane is mid-build. This step is the general home. It extends the same push-time hook that red-run-pre-push (Red-run line) and lint-before-record-push (STE lint) extend, and it calls the lane lint's own check list rather than a copy (building-one-home-per-capability). Scope question for the lane: which lane-lint checks are fast enough for every push. The record states the cost per push (process starts, reads) and a test proves it. Done check: a red test where a push that sends a commit the silent-undo check fails is refused before it leaves. The guard's verdict changes, so this is a build lane (test-author, builder, reviewer). Filed by triage 08:13 CST Nov 8. Started by the coordinator 08:14 CST Nov 8 in lane [ended:lane:-lane-lint-before-push], built on #1582's hook. Lane pick 10:49 CST Nov 8: keep the commit-plus-push refusal (item 431 withdrawn 10:51 CST: the pick can be undone, so it is the lane's); debt lane-lint-chain-blanket-deny. Lane 11:25 CST Nov 8: the debt is renamed lane-lint-chain-refusal (the glossary check refuses the old word); its record says the refusal is kept as the lane's call (item 423 ruling). Incidents #2077 refuses (lane notes-fix-reverify-large, 11:29 CST Nov 8): #1597 (merge f7737da9b, docs/decisions/ci-job-caps.md) and #1668 (merge 1b068d9e1, hooks/guard_frozen.py), both Nov 8: a main merge with an unmarked dropped line. Incident folded in (coordinator 13:04 CST Nov 8, proposed step handoff-needs-lane-lint): lane override-plain-ask ([ended:lane:-override-plain-ask]) handed #1463, #1513 and #1583 to runner 8 at 11:49 CST before linting them, and all three failed lint. Also cover the hand-off: refuse a lane's hand-off message to a batch runner for a PR whose live head has no passing `merge --lane-lint`. Sighting, lane lint-before-record-push 13:10 CST Nov 8 (routed by the coordinator 13:13 CST): check_comment_narration caught test comments that cite rulings and dates twice in one lane (#1898, #2032); only the lane lint caught them. Sighting (coordinator 13:30 CST Nov 8): lane open-asks-listed-at-wake ([ended:open-asks-listed-at-wake]) sent runner 8 a hand-off with no PR and no record. The follow-up that refuses a hand-off with no passing lint covers it. Two incidents (coordinator 14:24 and 14:25 CST Nov 8), folded here instead of new steps lane-lint-at-handed-head and lane-lint-before-handoff: (1) lane time-from-one-helper ([ended:lane:-time-from-one-helper]) reported lane lint from an older head in a hand-off, and the real head failed; #2266 had the same shape (record and lint below the live head). (2) lane cite-range-symbol-match ([ended:lane:-cite-range-symbol-match]) learned of an STE001 fail only after its first hand-off of #2196, then hand-split rule sentences, and two splits lost meaning ("whole statement", "only"). Guard candidates: `merge --review-record` refuses unless a lane-lint PASS is logged for that exact head; check_red_run runs before a lane pushes; the record is posted before any push after the last round (see record-before-fix-push). Sighting (coordinator 14:57 CST Nov 8): lane report-guard-fix-check-record (#2267) pushed notes lines that broke the STE limit, and lane lint failed later. It proposes running ste-changed against origin/main before a docs push. Sighting (lane comment-check-scans-shell, [ended:lane:-comment-check-scans-shell], 15:40 CST Nov 8; it proposed step carry-silent-undo-prepush, folded here): it pushed carry merges (#1840 to #1856 to #1909) that re-wrapped or moved lines with no `Drops-lines:` trailer; only lane lint caught it, on #1856 at 4cd008898 (15:24 CST). Harm: a wasted lane-lint run per carry, and a failing head on a PR. Proposed: before a push of a merge commit to a lane branch, run `python3 lint/check_silent_undo.py --upstream origin/main --head <sha>` (about 5 s) and refuse on FAIL. Lane 15:40 CST Nov 8: #2178 (lane-lint-push, with runner 8, lane lint PASS at a5031bb4f) already covers the carry sighting: before every push it runs the silent-undo step against origin's default branch, merge commits included, a Drops-lines trailer excusing; a chained commit and push is refused. Measured 0.3-2.5 s per push on 7 lane tips. No new work. Coordinator (13:00 CST Nov 9): three more incidents today. A lane's merge of main that dropped or changed main's lines was found only by the lane lint's silent-undo check, after review, so #2378, #1367 and #2413 each lost a lint round. Proposed scope: run check_silent_undo on a merge commit before its push. Coordinator (13:03 CST Nov 9), from lane review-record-provenance (#2440, [ended:Lane:-review-record-provenance]): folded candidate narration-lint-before-push: the comment-narration lint runs before a push too. Lane revive-1042 (13:55 CST Nov 9): folded candidate merge-runs-rule-audit. A second main merge into #1971 kept a stale UNMECHANIZED_EXPECTED, because the text merge was clean and rule_audit did not run; fixed in 5c5088534. Scope: run lint/rule_audit.py before the push of any merge that touches lint/rule_mechanisms.json. Fold (12:21 CST Nov 10, outbox sweep, owner pick 493 a): home roadmap step lane-ready-ste-verdict (2bbe917): a lane's hand-off is refused on a failing STE lint; ste-changed is not in merge --lane-lint on main, so the lane adds it.
